merged: **Domaine des Trois Chênes – Handover Summary (≤150 words)** - **Vineyard:** 18 ha on clay‑flint; 11 ha Cabernet Franc, 7 ha Chenin Blanc. - **Production:** ~62 000 bottles/year; 2024 output fell to 48 000 after a May hailstorm damaged the western plots (≈20‑25 % loss). - **Certification:** Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion started 2023, earliest certification expected 2026. - **Exports:** 41 % of volume, mainly Belgium and Japan. Japan market limits sulphites to <60 mg/L. - **Past incidents:** - 2022 Tank 4 controller temperature drift cost €11 000; now calibrated pre‑harvest with a second probe. - 2023 label mis‑print recalled 900 bottles; proof‑signing now requires two signatures. - **Operational rules:** No irrigation on western plots; harvest dates set after three consecutive mornings of sugar/acidity readings; any tank exceeding 28 °C must be cooled within four hours. - **Open items (uncertain):** Lighter‑weight bottle option – importer interest unconfirmed, no cost comparison.
